headline: Reserve Bank of India Imposes Monetary Penalty on Fusion Finance
summary: The Reserve Bank of India imposed a monetary penalty of ₹7.50 lakh on Fusion Finance Limited for non-compliance with KYC and Internal Ombudsman directions.
why: Regulatory penalties highlight compliance risks and adherence failures regarding central bank directives for financial institutions.

impacts.name: Fusion Finance Limited
impacts.why: The Reserve Bank of India imposed a monetary penalty on the company.
